description: Greedily union the least-separated learned positional scalar groups
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,105 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 17 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0074, the thirteenth positional union at 2,105 parameters and 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034, shared normalization biases. Hypothesis: further parameterization-preserving unions of the numerically closest learned positional scalar groups can remove parameters while preserving the represented checkpoint closely enough to qualify. Candidate ordering is ascending absolute difference between current group values, excluding any group pair already rejected within this automation; this is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because each trial is by definition the minimum-distortion eligible union. Each micro-trial changes exactly one group union and is accepted or rolled back solely by run_attempt.py under the strict fewer-parameters and at-least-99% rule. Stop after 20 micro-trials, immediately on an execution error, or if no eligible pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications, 30 minutes wall-clock.
summary: Ran 1 of 20 declared micro-trials and stopped immediately on the first error. The candidate was not trained or verified: an implementation error in the helper removed the closing parenthesis of the prior tied pair, producing a SyntaxError in src/model.py. Frontier remained 2,105 parameters at 99.05%; 0 accepted, 1 error, negligible training compute.
